name: raycast-mise
title: Mise Toolchain Inspector
description: Browse installed mise tools, settings, environment variables and doctor output
author: hasansezertasan

commands.name: mise-list-all-tools
commands.title: List Installed Tools
commands.subtitle: Mise
commands.description: Browse installed mise tools, copy install paths and uninstall versions

commands.name: mise-doctor
commands.title: Run Doctor
commands.subtitle: Mise
commands.description: Show the output of mise doctor

commands.name: mise-show-env-vars
commands.title: Show Environment Variables
commands.subtitle: Mise
commands.description: Show the environment variables mise exports from your global config

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
